steps: A set with \(2\) elements has \(2^{2}=4\) subsets.

The original set is one element of its power set, not the entire power set.

records.q: On \(A=\{1,2,\dots,4\}\), define \(iRj\) when \(i+j\) is even. How many ordered pairs are in \(R\)?
steps: A sum is even when the two numbers have the same parity.
Count odd–odd pairs and even–even pairs to obtain \(8\).

traps.why: Not every ordered pair has an even sum.
The relation includes many off-diagonal pairs as well as diagonal pairs.

This is the number of edges in a complete graph.

records.q: How many edges are in the complete graph \(K_5\)?
steps: Every pair of distinct vertices determines one edge.

traps.why: Loops and duplicate directions are not edges of a simple complete graph.
This counts each undirected edge twice.
That is the edge count of a tree, not a complete graph.
